_comment: GCB-032 - EPIC TKT-018 Measurement Epoch Story 4, per TKT-000. Physical validation of the GCB-031 mid-tree pipelined gcb_max_reduce. EXACT same flow as GCB-029 (asap7, 1000 ps SDC, default deliberately-ugly recipe, REG_STAGES=2 via VERILOG_TOP_PARAMS) with NO SYNTH_RETIME_MODULES - the netlist is the sv2v of the GCB-031 rtl/gcb_max_reduce.sv (mid-tree genvar segments). Question: does the RTL pipeline alone close 1 ns, and at what cost vs GCB-030's synthesis retiming? Raw measurement.
params: WIDTH=16 N_ELEMENTS=64 OUTPUT=BOTH REG_STAGES=2  (GCB-031 mid-tree pipeline: 2 register banks BETWEEN tournament levels 2 and 4)

flow.identical_to: GCB-029 (same constraint.sdc @ 1000 ps, same floorplan/place/route knobs CORE_UTILIZATION=40 CORE_ASPECT_RATIO=1 CORE_MARGIN=2 PLACE_DENSITY=0.55 SKIP_LAST_GASP=1, default recipe)
flow.only_diff_vs_gcb029: netlist is sv2v of the GCB-031 rtl/gcb_max_reduce.sv (mid-tree). REG_STAGES=2 still applied via VERILOG_TOP_PARAMS -> chparam -set REG_STAGES 2 -> hierarchy re-elaborates the for(genvar p=0;p<=K;p++):g_seg segments.
flow.vs_gcb030: NO SYNTH_RETIME_MODULES line - relying strictly on the RTL mid-tree pipeline
flow.note: -j 2 cold-race hit '2_1_floorplan.sdc' as in GCB-027/029/030; ran synth then the rest serially (-j 1 respects the -j 2 ceiling).

verdict_one_line: WNS = 0.00 ps, 0 setup violations, fmax 1.519 GHz - the GCB-031 mid-tree RTL pipeline CLOSES 1 ns WITHOUT synthesis retiming, at 372 flops / 715 um2 synth area / 9.37 mW - roughly HALF GCB-030 retiming's 818 flops, -29% synth area, -23% power, -33% max-slew DRVs. 38 max-slew DRVs remain (the mid-tree bank-1 fan-out; needs a slew-repair pass, deliberately not run).

transfer_function._note: GCB-029 (REG_STAGES=2 output pipe, no retiming) -> GCB-030 (retiming ON) -> GCB-032 (GCB-031 mid-tree RTL, no retiming)

wns_ps.result: MET - all setup paths MET, cone broken

worst_setup_slack_ps.note: GCB-032 tightest path: g_reg_out.bnk_val[bank2][*] -> max_val[1] output (last segment, tree levels 4-5). reg->reg core_clock worst = +341.47 ps. input vec_flat -> bank0 = +262.15 ps. None is input->max_val combinational.

max_slew_violation_count.note: NOT zero - the mid-tree bank-1 registers latch 16 partial winners x 22 b from the level-2 fold; those data nets fan out beyond the default (no-last-gasp) recipe's buffering. Fewer than retiming's 57 (no replicated async-reset fan-out); a SKIP_LAST_GASP=0 slew-repair pass would clear them - deliberately not run per the 'ugly first' doctrine.

flop_count_DFFASRHQN.note: GCB-031 Yosys 0.68 bless predicted ~440 flop BITS across 42 $adff (bank1 16x22, bank2 4x22); ABC on the ASAP7 path maps them to 372 physical DFFASRHQN. NO replication - contrast retiming's 46 -> 818.

synth_cell_count.note: GCB-032 ~= GCB-029 - the tournament fold is unchanged, just sliced. Retiming's 8208 re-optimised the datapath.

HAxp5_count.note: IDENTICAL to GCB-029 - the index (argmax) cone is untouched by mid-tree cuts. Retiming's 827 shows it mangled the cone.

cts.gcb032: 372 clock sinks, 27 clock buffers + 13 clock inverters, setup skew 6.73 ps

critical_path.worst_path_type: register bank -> output through the last segment (g_reg_out.bnk_val[bank2][*] -> max_val[1], +90.27 ps). Also port->bank (vec_flat -> bank0, +262 ps) and bank->bank (+341 ps) segments. NONE is the input->max_val combinational cone that GCB-027 (-665 ps) and GCB-029 (-442 ps) measured.
critical_path.async_reset: 372 DFFASRHQN result flops, async set/reset - NOT replicated (RTL banks, not retimed). recovery/removal checks on rst_n MET (+138 ps min).
critical_path.mechanism: GCB-031 places 2 register banks after tree levels 2 and 4 (mr_cut_lvl floor-distribution over LEVELS=6, nseg=3). The ~1.67 ns cone is split into three ~2-level segments; each closes 1 ns with margin (worst segment +90 ps at the I/O boundary, +341 ps reg->reg).

orange_verdict: The GCB-031 falsifiable prediction is CONFIRMED on the load-bearing axis: mid-tree RTL cuts close 1 ns WITHOUT retiming (WNS 0.00 ps, 0 setup violations, fmax 1.519 GHz, cone broken into port/reg->reg segments). And they do it at roughly HALF the cost of GCB-030's synthesis retiming: 372 vs 818 flops (-54.5%), 715 vs 1013 um2 synth area (-29.4%), 810 vs 1137 um2 post-route (-28.7%), 9.37 vs 12.2 mW (-23.2%), 23208 vs 29069 um wirelength (-20.2%), and the index/HAxp5 cone is left intact (1008 == GCB-029's 1008; retiming re-optimised it to 827). The prediction is PARTIALLY FALSIFIED on DRVs: 38 max-slew violations remain (vs the predicted 0). They are the mid-tree bank-1 fan-out (16 partial winners x 22 b off the level-2 fold), a structural trait of any register bank at this width - fewer than retiming's 57, no replicated reset fan-out, and clearable with a slew-repair pass (SKIP_LAST_GASP=0) that the deliberately-ugly recipe skips. Detail-route DRC is 0.
decision: GCB-031's mid-tree pipeline is the physically-validated way to close gcb_max_reduce at 1 GHz. SYNTH_RETIME_MODULES for this block is retired - it closed timing (GCB-030) but by 17.8x register replication. A follow-on GCB-### can (a) push REG_STAGES=2 + the mid-tree config into the shared ORFS flow / update docs/PPA_burndown.md, and (b) measure a SKIP_LAST_GASP=0 slew-repair pass to clear the 38 max-slew DRVs. OUTPUT="VALUE" (drop the 1008-HAxp5 index cone) remains an orthogonal trade.
